name: Exp_CCI_Woodies
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover of fast and slow CCI (Woodies) indicators. It opens buy positions when the fast CCI crosses above the slow CCI and sell positions when the fast CCI crosses below the slow CCI. Positions are closed on opposite crossover signals, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Woodies CCI快速线和慢速线的交叉信号进行交易。快速CCI上穿慢速CCI时开多仓，下穿时开空仓。反向交叉信号触发平仓，支持可配置的资金管理和止损止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Woodies CCI指标的双线交叉策略，核心概念是利用快速CCI（默认周期6）和慢速CCI（默认周期14）的相对位置变化捕捉动量转换。入场条件为：快速CCI上穿慢速CCI时开多仓，快速CCI下穿慢速CCI时开空仓，采用前一根K线的交叉确认机制（SignalBar=1），避免未来数据偏差。出场条件为：持有多仓时快速CCI下穿慢速CCI触发平仓，持有空仓时快速CCI上穿慢速CCI触发平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于自由保证金、基于余额、基于扣除亏损后的自由保证金、基于扣除亏损后的余额。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1手，并设有1000点止损和2000点止盈。EA还支持信号反转（Invert参数），允许将做多和做空信号互换，适合逆势交易场景。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual CCI crossover strategy using the Woodies CCI indicator, where the core concept is capturing momentum shifts through the relative position changes between a fast CCI (default period 6) and a slow CCI (default period 14). Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the fast CCI crosses above the slow CCI, and a sell position opens when the fast CCI crosses below the slow CCI, using a one-bar lag confirmation (SignalBar=1) to avoid look-ahead bias. Exit conditions are: a long position closes when the fast CCI crosses below the slow CCI, and a short position closes when the fast CCI crosses above the slow CCI. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot size, based on free margin, based on balance, based on free margin minus losses, and based on balance minus losses. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 lots, along with a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit. The EA also supports signal inversion via the Invert parameter, which swaps buy and sell signals for counter-trend trading scenarios.

parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots, balance percentage, etc.)

parameters.description_en: Close long positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose

parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0 for current bar)

pros: 使用双CCI交叉策略，快慢线配合能有效捕捉动量转换时机
支持五种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好和账户规模
信号确认使用前一根K线（SignalBar=1），避免未来数据偏差，回测结果更可靠
提供信号反转功能，可在不同市场环境中灵活切换顺势和逆势模式
买卖开仓和平仓可独立控制，便于只交易单边或只使用信号平仓
pros_en: Dual CCI crossover strategy effectively captures momentum shifts with fast/slow line coordination
Five position sizing modes offer flexibility for different risk appetites and account sizes
Signal confirmation using previous bar (SignalBar=1) avoids look-ahead bias, making backtesting more reliable
Signal inversion feature allows switching between trend-following and counter-trend modes for different market conditions
Independent controls for buy/sell opening and closing enable one-direction-only trading or signal-only exits
cons: CCI交叉策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号，导致反复亏损
缺少趋势过滤器，无法区分趋势行情和横盘行情，在无趋势市场中表现差
止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未考虑市场波动率（ATR），在不同品种和时段上可能不适用
没有交易时间过滤，可能在流动性差的时段产生不利成交
依赖自定义指标CCI_Woodies，如果指标文件缺失EA将无法运行，增加了部署复杂度
cons_en: CCI crossover strategy prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets, causing repeated losses
Lacks a trend filter to distinguish trending from sideways markets, performing poorly in trendless conditions
Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP do not account for market volatility (ATR), potentially unsuitable across different instruments and timeframes
No trading session filter, which may lead to unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
Depends on custom indicator CCI_Woodies; if the indicator file is missing the EA fails to initialize, increasing deployment complexity
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整止损止盈距离，提高适应性
增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更大周期MA），在无趋势时减少交易频率，避免震荡市亏损
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to automatically adjust exit levels based on market volatility for better adaptability
Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher-timeframe MA) to reduce trading frequency during sideways markets and avoid losses in ranging conditions

risk_points: CCI交叉在震荡行情中产生大量虚假信号，可能导致连续亏损
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率，在高波动时止损可能过小导致频繁触发
缺少最大持仓数限制和最大回撤保护，极端行情下风险不可控
risk_points_en: CCI crossovers generate numerous false signals in ranging markets, potentially causing consecutive losses
Fixed SL/TP does not account for volatility; stop loss may be too tight in high-volatility conditions leading to frequent triggers
No maximum position count limit or maximum drawdown protection, leaving risk uncontrolled during extreme market conditions
